title: Classroom Lecture: Live Engineering Exposition (Audio Recording Voice)

assessment_targets.what_taught_summary: The lecture introduces the high-level structure and scope of the live engineering exposition, establishing the foundational context for the subsequent technical procedures.
assessment_targets.why_assessed_pedagogy: This assessment verifies that students have correctly identified and retained the introductory framework and key terminology presented at the start of the session.
misconception_distractor_hints: Confusing the introductory overview with the specific procedural steps detailed later in the lecture.
Assuming the overview contains specific technical formulas or code examples rather than conceptual definitions.
Misidentifying the primary purpose of the introduction as providing detailed implementation instructions rather than setting the stage.
